script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say the witnesses were called to make the purchase official; that adds a reason.
Teaching the people again and again does not establish that all warnings are behind them.
“Nobody's sitting this one out” claims every individual took part. The verse names groups but does not address individual exceptions.
“God names everybody” goes beyond the groups named in the verse and suggests every individual is accounted for.
“He keeps teaching” presents the teaching as ongoing. God says He taught them again and again, without saying He is still doing so.
“So no jokes here” comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
The statement that the people turned their backs is in God's words, not Jeremiah's prayer.
The passage does not say Jeremiah's field was the first one bought.
